Stop obsessing over your logo and start obsessing over your stitch count. 

Nobody cares about your brand identity if the garment falls apart after three washes.

I am stuck between heavy-weight cotton or a custom blend for our first drop. 

Tell me why I am wrong if I choose heavy cotton for the silhouette.

Most guys think they need 50 items in their closet to be stylish. 

You really only need three perfect pieces that actually fit your body. 

What is the one item you refuse to compromise on.
